character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After escaping Commander Vance's server hub and surviving a holographic trap, Kael descended into a hidden sub-basement filled with ancient data crystals. Cornered by an unseen pursuer in the subterranean labyrinth, he absorbed deep-sea coordinates before triggering a cave-in and diving into an uncharted underground ocean trench.
